descriptionText:
The Official Modesty Blaise #1 (Pioneer Comics, 1988) -- first issue of Pioneer's reprints of the classic Peter O'Donnell / Jim Holdaway newspaper strip. "International intrigue and danger." Holdaway cover art. Cover price $2.00 US.

Condition: Very Good. Cover clean with light handling wear. Please review the photos - they are of the actual copy you will receive.
